verdict.rationale: UCP is clearly a versioned, openly published protocol. A probe found ucp.dev serving a versioned spec index with dated releases (2026-08-25, 2026-04-08), and the live MCP server returns an x-shopify-ucp-mcp-api-version header. Profiles declare protocol version for server-selects negotiation, and the spec and reference implementations live on public GitHub. The conformance/validation half is thin: the only UCP-specific checks are runtime ones, namely live input-schema introspection via `--input-schema` and server-side rejection of invalid profiles (invalid_profile_url). The AI Toolkit's schema validation covers GraphQL, Liquid and Extensions, not UCP payloads. Missing for 10: a dedicated UCP conformance test suite or offline validator, a downloadable machine-readable schema (Shopify OpenAPI paths return 404), and independent hands-on evidence of conformance testing.
